parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `MockDeviceContext` located at `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/Mocks/MockDeviceContext.swift`, which is unambiguously a test mock fixture. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a test- or mock-marked record must be treated as intentional duplication. The mock exists precisely to mirror the shape of the production `DeviceContext` (at `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Throttling/DeviceContext.swift`) so that tests can substitute it; collapsing or lifting shared structure would couple production code to test semantics. No structural evidence fields (jaccard, shared_field_count, etc.) were populated, further reducing confidence in any action signal.
